Title: Highfield Therapy
Welcome: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. I offer warm, confidential, professional therapy to help you navigate life's challenges — online, or in person here in Sheffield.
About: My name is Robert. Alongside more than 15 years' experience in education, I've supported people through trauma, bereavement and crisis, including work with a charity supporting survivors of trafficking and modern slavery, with Cruse and with Samaritans. I'm committed to ongoing training and CPD, and to learning more about how I can help people.
Therapy: I'm a humanistic therapist with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA). I offer both open-ended counselling and shorter, more focused pieces of work. Sessions are available online, or in person from a private garden room where you can talk openly about your concerns.
Fees: Sessions are £50, and I offer concessions to those on a low or no income. I can arrange a free 15-minute phone consultation to talk about how I can help and answer any questions you may have about therapy, then book an in-person or online appointment.
Contact: I'm based in Sheffield, a 20-minute walk from Sheffield Central station and close to a tram stop, with plenty of free on-street parking. To get in touch, call or message 07946827431, or use the email button below.
